prs.title: fix: Sheet fixes from testing
prs.author: devongovett
prs.body:
* Adds `overscroll-behavior: auto` to the Tailwind example to enable scroll chaining so that you can swipe the sheet away when scrolled to the top of the content.
* Adds `scrollbar-gutter: stable` to the content so that when swiping it away the scrollbar appearing and disappearing does not cause layout shifts.
* Fixes the exit point on iOS Safari so the sheet travels entirely off the screen when swiping instead of disappearing when it reaches the floating toolbar. The viewport units (even `100lvh`) end above the toolbar, but additional content is still visible behind it. This adds additional padding to the snap points so that you can swipe the sheet entirely off the screen.
* Improves the snap points example in the docs so it has a fake map and some reviews to demonstrate scrolling behavior inside a sheet.
